name: Town life
description: Rumours, city districts and the quirks that make townsfolk memorable.

tables.name: Rumour
tables.description: What people are saying over their drinks.

rows.text: Word is [[Rumour Subject]] and [[Rumour Subject]] are secretly working together.

rows: A caravan went into the hills a month ago and only the horses came back.
Someone is paying good coin for rat tails, and nobody knows why.
The old well in the square is whispering again.
A ship came in last night with no crew and a full hold.
The harvest festival is cancelled this year, by order, with no reason given.
There is a door in the cellars under the temple that was not there last week.
A wolf the size of a pony was seen at the edge of town.
The mint has been making coins a little lighter than they should be.
A travelling fortune teller is always right, and people are scared of her.
Someone keeps leaving flowers on a grave nobody remembers digging.
The river fish have gone, all of them, overnight.
Two families are about to settle an old feud with a wedding, or with knives.

the cobbles are being torn up for a new sewer
